_README: Calibration block for src/virtual_dyno.py — the DETERMINISTIC virtual dyno.
No LLM touches this file. Every number carries a unit and a source.
Anything marked needs_confirmation=true is an ESTIMATE that has not been
checked against Joshua's own bike / a published H-D spec sheet / a real
dyno sheet. The dyno echoes those flags back in baseline_status so the UI
can show them next to every result.
NOTE: timing_backbone and belly_derate_deg are NOT stored here — they are
owned by src/guardrails.py (TIMING_BACKBONE / BELLY_DERATE_DEG) and are
imported from there so there is exactly one copy in the codebase.
label: 2023 Harley-Davidson Low Rider ST (FXLRST) — Milwaukee-Eight 131ci, 2-into-1, ThunderMax TBW
calibration_status: UNCALIBRATED — first-order physics model seeded from published 131ci kit charts and shop tune notes. No real dyno sheet for THIS bike has been folded in. Treat every number as directional (±15%), never as a measurement.

engine.ve_peak_source: ESTIMATE. A 131 crate motor with a free-flowing 2-into-1 is assumed to just break 100% VE at the peak-torque rpm. Chosen so the closed-form injector duty at WOT lands in the 70-85% band the shop expects with 5.5 g/s injectors. CONFIRM against a datalog: read actual VE-table cells at 3500 rpm / 100% TPS in TMax Tuner.
engine.ve_curve_shape: VE(rpm) = ve_peak * baseline_torque(rpm) / peak_torque — torque is proportional to trapped air mass at fixed AFR/timing, so the torque curve IS the VE curve, normalised.

baseline._note: Published-chart anchors for the 131 kit. hp = torque * rpm / 5252.

anchor_peak_torque.source: Published Screamin' Eagle 131 crate-engine torque chart (~140 lb-ft @ ~3500 rpm).

anchor_peak_hp.source: Published Screamin' Eagle 131 crate-engine hp chart (~125 hp @ ~5500 rpm). 125 hp @ 5500 rpm == 119.4 lb-ft, which is the 5500 rpm point of torque_curve below.

baseline.redline_source: M8 Softail rev limiter ~5750-5800 rpm. needs_confirmation — read the limiter cell in TMax Tuner.
baseline.torque_curve_unit: [rpm, lb-ft] at the crank, at the baseline AFR/timing state
baseline.torque_curve_source: Smooth curve drawn THROUGH the two published anchors (140 lb-ft @ 3500, and 125 hp @ 5500 -> 119.4 lb-ft @ 5500) with a typical big-inch pushrod V-twin shape either side. Interpolated in code with monotone cubic Hermite (PCHIP) so it is C1-smooth and never overshoots the anchors.

injectors.source: thundermax_nas_readme_tune_notes.md — 'Injector Scaling: Calibrated for 5.5g/sec' for base map ZZSSQXETDN100720
injectors._why_this_matters: Stock M8 injectors are ~4.4 g/s. Seeding the model with 4.4 instead of 5.5 inflates every duty-cycle reading by ~25% and would false-red a perfectly healthy pull.

afr.wot_target_source: Midpoint of guardrails.AFR_WOT (12.4-12.8), the shop's validated WOT window.
afr.stoich_source: Pump gasoline. (E10 is nearer 14.1; 14.7 keeps the model consistent with the AFR numbers TMax Tuner displays.)

gearing.source: Standard Milwaukee-Eight Cruise Drive 6-speed ratios for the 2018+ Softail platform, back-solved so that primary * trans * final reproduces the commonly published Softail OVERALL ratios (1st ~9.59 ... 6th ~2.87). NOT read off an H-D spec sheet for the 2023 FXLRST specifically — confirm the four items in _confirm_these before trusting any mph number.
gearing.primary_ratio_unit: reduction (crank revs per primary-output rev), 46/34 chain
gearing.final_drive_ratio_unit: reduction (trans-output revs per rear-wheel rev), belt
gearing._gear_note: On the Cruise Drive, 6th is the true 1.000:1 and 5th (1.185) is the nearest ratio below it. The virtual dyno defaults to gear 5 (spec default) because a top-gear pull is too slow to reach redline inside a 20 s window. The gear used is echoed in every sample and in the summary.
gearing.tire_rolling_circumference_unit: m per rear-wheel revolution (loaded/rolling, not free geometric)
gearing.tire_source: 180/55-17 geometric circumference is 1.978 m; loaded rolling circumference is ~1.92-1.94 m. 1.93 assumed.

vehicle._note: Used ONLY to turn torque into an rpm-vs-time ramp so the gauges sweep at a believable rate. It does not affect torque, hp, AFR, duty or knock.
vehicle.mass_kg_unit: kg (bike wet ~318 kg / 700 lb + ~90 kg rider)
vehicle.driveline_efficiency_unit: fraction (crank -> rear wheel, chain primary + belt final)
vehicle.cda_m2_unit: m^2 (drag coefficient x frontal area; rider tucked behind the ST fairing)

conditions_default.iat_f_unit: degF — intake air temperature; when null the model uses ambient_f + iat_rise_f
conditions_default.iat_rise_f_note: Airbox heat soak on an M8 is real (often +10 to +25 degF) but unmeasured here, so the default rise is 0. Supply a measured iat_f from a datalog for a better duty number.
conditions_default.baro_inhg_unit: inHg — absolute barometric pressure (29.92 = ISA sea level)
conditions_default.cht_f_note: STATIC INPUT ECHO. CHT cannot be simulated meaningfully over a 15 s pull, so the dyno echoes this constant in every frame and flags it at t=0 if it is already past a guardrail gate (200 / 226 / 280 degF). 220 degF default = hot air-cooled twin, just under the 226 degF heat-retard knee.

pull.tps_pct_note: A pull is wide-open throttle by definition.

band_edge._note: Worst-case band-edge envelope: a changed cell that borders an unchanged cell blends across the boundary, so the real bike can see part of the change slightly outside the band Joshua typed. The dyno re-runs the pull with every band widened by one cell in each direction and labels any NEW finding 'worst-case band edge'.
band_edge.rpm_cell_unit: rpm — TMax rpm-axis step. Inferred from the house decel-pop bands in guardrails.py (2048/2816/3840/4608 are all multiples of 256).
band_edge.tps_cell_unit: %TPS — assumed column width of the TMax rpm x TPS grid

banner: DIRECTIONAL ONLY — this is a first-order physics model, NOT a dyno. It shows which way a change moves things and roughly how far. Nothing here replaces a validation ride or a real dyno sheet.
